title: Atlas Crossing Partners | Pinecrest Foods | LBO Model — Overview
summary: Full LBO model for Pinecrest Foods (Atlas Crossing Partners Fund III), covering entry in September 2020 through projected FY2027E exit. The workbook includes an overview & assumptions sheet with sources & uses ($168.75M entry EV at 12.5× EBITDA), a detailed income statement (FY2020A–FY2027E), a debt schedule tracking a senior term loan and PIK mezz facility, and a returns summary. Base case projects exit EV of $314.6M at 11.0× FY2027E EBITDA of $28.6M, producing a gross MOIC of 2.86× and gross IRR of ~16.2% on a 7-year hold. An add-on acquisition (Harvest Ridge Snacks, ~$38M) is modeled in Q2 2023. Revenue grows from $65.4M at entry to $162.4M at exit; EBITDA margin compresses modestly from 20.6% to 17.6% over the hold period.

growth_drivers: Add-on acquisition of Harvest Ridge Snacks in Q2 2023 (~$38M)
Gross margin stability at 44% throughout hold period
Free cash flow sweep for debt paydown
risks: PIK mezz debt accretes significantly (from $20.2M to $48.4M by FY2027E), increasing net debt at exit
EBITDA margin compression from 20.6% to 17.6% over hold period
High entry leverage (7.1× Debt/EBITDA at entry)
Integration risk from Harvest Ridge Snacks add-on
Negative/near-zero unlevered FCF in entry year (FY2020A: -$0.5M)
Bear case at 7.0× exit multiple yields sub-1.0× MOIC
